products.tagline: Crafted to Seal, Made to Heal

description.about: Bio-Vion is Dentessa's next-generation injectable bioceramic root canal sealer, engineered to deliver a superior hermetic seal, excellent biocompatibility, and effortless clinical handling. Developed for the modern endodontist, Bio-Vion's single-component premixed formula eliminates the need for mixing and sets in the presence of moisture — working with the clinical environment rather than against it. Compatible with cold and warm obturation techniques, Bio-Vion integrates seamlessly into single cone, lateral compaction, or thermoplasticised gutta percha workflows, giving clinicians the freedom to work in their preferred technique without compromise.
indications: Compatible with both cold and warm obturation techniques
Suitable for use with single cone, lateral compaction, or thermoplasticised gutta percha techniques
